mentions.name: SpikeLog
mentions.description: A simple metrics tracker for logging numbers and visualizing their change over time, positioned as a middle ground between complex observability platforms and manually tracking a value yourself.
mentions.problem: Complex observability platforms are overkill, while tracking a number yourself and finding a way to visualize its change over time is cumbersome.
mentions.source_excerpt: A few weeks ago I built a very simple metrics tracker that I had been looking for myself... a middle ground between complex observability platforms and tracking a number yourself and then finding a way to visualise its change over time.

evidence.value: A few weeks ago I built a very simple metrics tracker that I had been looking for myself... a middle ground between complex observability platforms and tracking a number yourself and then finding a way to visualise its change over time.
